title: xds : Nil pointer dereference error
body:
### What version of gRPC are you using?
1.46.0

### What version of Go are you using (`go version`)?
1.18

### What operating system (Linux, Windows, …) and version?
Linux

### What did you do?
Using xds as client side loadbalancer for GCP traffic director service.

`_ "google.golang.org/grpc/xds"`

We're seeing this in production environment and service is clashing.

### What did you expect to see?
client work normal and was not expecting to crash.

### What did you see instead?
